Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

title: LATAM Engineering Director - Power Conversion
description:
Job Description Summary

The Director of Engineering leads a comprehensive organization of Design, Product, Test and Process engineers responsible for the end-to-end design of Large Rotating Machines (motors, generators and synchronous condensers), Transformers, Power Drives, Switch Gear and Complex Systems for a variety of industry segments. With design authority (under corporate standards), you will be responsible for major and complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within functional areas of expertise, and be instrumental to the overall business strategy.

Job Description

Role Summary/Purpose:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for the Power Conversion and Storage division in Latin America, the LATAM Director of Engineering will lead Engineering on Rotating machines (induction, DC, synchronous, PMM, synch reluctance, and other topologies) and Engineering of integrated electrical solutions (system design and integration, power electronics, automation, switchboards and installation) for products and projects within LATAM or exported from LATAM to many global regions, notably North America, Europe and the Middle East.

The role is both operational and strategic. It demands:

  • Transformational leadership skills – to guide the large organizational structure towards productivity, process standardization & maturity, speed and use of leading edge technology tools;

  • Technical depth – to foster an environment of creativity and innovative solutions, and to develop new business opportunities;

  • Seniority and executive presence – to interact with the customers in Latin America and abroad on complex engineering projects.

  • The role requires focus towards growth on the Latam region operation, and he/she will leverage the GE network, to drive product innovation, technology injections, structuring and cost-out through tools and processes in the areas of power electronics, automation, power systems, switchgears, rotor dynamics, vibration, electromagnetics, insulation, aero-thermo, structural, and both electrical and mechanical systems integration.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • The LATAM Director of Engineering directs a functional area of several engineering departments across the sites of Campinas, SP and Belo Horizonte, MG. Executes projects with great customer engagement and trust. Translates concepts, considers strategic options, develops tactics, and implements change. Creates programs in alignment with the external environment. Participates in cross-functional , multi-cultural teams.

  • Drives team performance to meet aggressive time and cost demands from our customers.

  • Develop, implement, and achieve performance KPIs.

  • Develop a roadmap for building world-class products and solutions, including electric machines, power electronics, switchgears, software and overall systems design capability.

  • Serves as technical expert in the technical community through demonstrated technical accomplishments which may include holding patents, component design and systems design experience, and strong knowledge of engineering design fundamentals.

  • Drives customer project execution and delivers on time and quality.

  • Leads and oversees quality engineering design, execution, and product safety; responsible for the oversight of the related sciences including materials and performance.

  • Provides guidance, leadership, mentoring and intervention, as necessary, to strengthen the discipline, quality, reliability and rigor of our engineering work.

  • Leads interactions with customers on technical issues.

  • Works with Power Conversion leadership to develop and build long term strategies.

  • Interacts with P&L engineering and technology leaders across GE to accelerate deployment of modern electrical and mechanical design tools and methodologies.

  • Works with P&L product leadership to reshape the overall Latam technical strategy and the organizational structure.

  • Provides leadership with high integrity and oversight of processes protecting intellectual property, export controlled and strategic technology.

Required Qualification:

  • Degree in Electric or Mechanical Engineering
  • Strong knowledge of Engineering Design Fundamentals and Engineering Processes
  • Extensive experience in mechanical and/or electrical systems design
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese mandatory
  • Industrial experience in relevant industry segments such as Oil and Gas, Power Generation, Mining & Steel and/or Marine will be a plus.
  • Subject Matter Expertise on Rotating Machines and/or Electrical Systems will be a plus.

Additional Information

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.

Nosso compromisso é garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Qual a missão do Cargo?

O Subscription Services Leader é a liderança estratégica responsável por estruturar, escalar e consolidar o Pool de Ofertas de Subscription Services da consultoria da Sensedia, transformando capacidades técnicas recorrentes em um modelo sustentável, previsível e orientado a valor contínuo para os clientes. Sua missão é consolidar o modelo de serviços recorrentes da consultoria como um dos pilares estratégicos de crescimento, garantindo previsibilidade de receita, aumento de margem e fortalecimento do relacionamento contínuo com os clientes.

Com forte visão de negócio e mentalidade orientada a serviços recorrentes, possui experiência na construção e gestão de modelos baseados em receita previsível (ARR/MRR), governança contratual e eficiência operacional. Atua como responsável por transformar competências técnicas em ofertas padronizadas, escaláveis e financeiramente sustentáveis.

Domina e acompanha de forma estruturada as principais métricas de SaaS aplicáveis ao modelo de Subscription Services, como ARR, MRR, churn, Net Dollar Retention (NDR), CAC, LTV, margem, expansão de base e indicadores de adoção e engajamento. Utiliza esses indicadores como base para a tomada de decisão, priorização e evolução do portfólio.

É responsável por liderar a estratégia do portfólio de Subscription Services, estruturar pacotes de oferta, modelos de precificação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e governança operacional alinhada com demais stakeholders da Sensedia. Desenha e desdobra OKRs, metas e KPIs relacionados a crescimento, rentabilidade e satisfação do cliente, garantindo acompanhamento disciplinado e execução consistente.

Essa liderança tem como objetivo estratégico atingir R$ 10 milhões de ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) em Subscription Services até o final de 2026, via transição de contratos atuais ou novos que se enquadrem no modelo de Subscription Services, assegurando crescimento sustentável.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Estruturar e escalar o Pool de Subscription Services com ofertas claras, padronizadas e replicáveis
  • Definir e evoluir modelos de precificação, SLAs e governança operacional
  • Estabelecer, acompanhar e analisar métricas SaaS aplicáveis ao modelo de serviços recorrentes
  • Definir e desdobrar OKRs, metas e KPIs de receita recorrente, margem, retenção, expansão e satisfação.
  • Garantir eficiência operacional, qualidade consistente e experiência positiva do cliente
  • Conectar estratégia comercial, capacidade técnica e execução operacional.
  • Evoluir continuamente o portfólio com base em dados, feedback de clientes e oportunidades de mercado
  • Participar de agendas de pré-vendas ou de conversão de contratos de modelo tradicional da consultoria para subscription services
  • Trabalhar de forma transversal com Produto, Marketing, Vendas, Pré-vendas, Customer Success e Consultoria, assegurando que as ofertas sejam claras, executáveis e alinhadas ao plano estratégico da consultoria.
  • Ao estruturar e governar o modelo de Subscription Services com base em métricas, disciplina operacional e foco em cliente, essa liderança fortalece a previsibilidade financeira da consultoria, aumenta a recorrência de receita e sustenta o crescimento estratégico da Sensedia.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência na liderança ou gestão de iniciativas, projetos ou portfólio de serviços dentro de estruturas de serviços ou consultoria
  • Capacidade de estruturar e evoluir ofertas de serviços de forma organizada, escalável e orientada a valor para o cliente

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

title: Especialista em Desenvolvimento Tecnológico Jr (Linha de Luz Sussuarana) | Technical Specialist[...]
description:
Job description

Para atuar na Linha de Luz Sussuarana do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).

O(a) Especialista Técnico(a) atuará no projeto, construção, comissionamento e operação da linha de luz Sussuarana, dedicada a experimentos termomecânicos in situ e à síntese/processamento de materiais volumétricos sob altas pressões e temperaturas.

A posição é voltada a profissionais com forte formação técnica em instrumentação científica, engenharia mecânica, mecatrônica, materiais ou áreas correlatas, com experiência em integração de sistemas experimentais, automação e operação de equipamentos complexos. O(a) profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com pesquisadores da linha, contribuindo para a confiabilidade, segurança e desempenho da infraestrutura experimental e apoiando usuários durante a realização de experimentos.

English Version

To work in Sussuarana Beamline of the Brazilian Synchrotron Light Laboratory (LNLS).

The Technical Specialist will contribute to the design, construction, commissioning, and operation of the Sussuarana beamline, dedicated to in situ thermomechanical experiments and bulk material synthesis/processing under high pressure and high temperature.

The position targets professionals with a strong technical background in scientific instrumentation, mechanical/mechatronics/materials engineering, or related fields, with experience in experimental system integration, automation, and operation of complex equipment. The specialist will work closely with beamline scientists, contributing to the reliability, safety, and performance of the experimental infrastructure and supporting users during experiments.

Main responsibilities

  • Participar da montagem, integração e comissionamento de estações experimentais e sistemas auxiliares da linha de luz;
  • Operar e manter equipamentos para experimentos sob alta pressão e alta temperatura, incluindo dispositivos de ensaio termomecânico e prensas de grande volume;
  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas para automação, controle e aquisição de dados dos experimentos;
  • Preparar amostras e auxiliar na instalação de experimentos durante campanhas de usuários;
  • Apoiar, orientar e treinar usuários na operação segura dos equipamentos;
  • Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva, garantindo estabilidade operacional e disponibilidade da linha;
  • Documentar procedimentos operacionais, protocolos de segurança e rotinas de manutenção;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de engenharia, TI e pesquisadores para melhoria contínua da infraestrutura.

English Version

  • Participate in the assembly, integration, and commissioning of experimental stations and auxiliary beamline systems;
  • Operate and maintain equipment for high-pressure and high-temperature experiments, including thermomechanical testing devices and large-volume presses;
  • Develop technical solutions for experiment automation, control, and data acquisition;
  • Prepare samples and assist in experimental setup during user runs;
  • Support, guide, and train users in safe equipment operation;
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to ensure operational stability and beamline availability;
  • Document operating procedures, safety protocols, and maintenance routines;
  • Work with engineering, IT, and scientific teams for continuous infrastructure improvement.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Física, Engenharia (Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Materiais, Controle e Automação, Elétrica) ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação Completa em Física, Engenharia (Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Materiais, Controle e Automação, Elétrica) ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Experiência com instrumentação científica, sistemas eletromecânicos ou equipamentos laboratoriais complexos;
  • Experiência em integração de hardware, sensores, atuadores e sistemas de controle;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de programação e aquisição de dados (Python, EPICS, LabVIEW ou similares);
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambiente multidisciplinar e de suporte a usuários.

Desejável

  • Experiência com equipamentos para ensaios termo-mecânicos, manufatura aditiva de metais, e prensas de grande volume;
  • Experiência em grandes instalações científicas (síncrotrons, fontes de nêutrons ou laboratórios multiusuários);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de vácuo, criogenia, fornos, hidráulica ou pneumática;
  • Experiência com normas de segurança e análise de risco experimental.

English Version

  • Bachelor’s degree in Physics or Engineering (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Materials, Control & Automation, Electrical) or related fields;
  • Postgraduate degree in Physics, Engineering (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Materials, Control & Automation, Electrical) or related fields;
  • Intermediate English proficiency;
  • Experience with scientific instrumentation, electromechanical systems, or complex laboratory equipment;
  • Experience integrating hardware, sensors, actuators, and control systems;
  • Basic programming and data acquisition skills (Python, EPICS, LabVIEW, or similar);
  • Ability to work in a multidisciplinary, user-support environment.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience with thermomechanical testing equipment, metal additive manufacturing, or large-volume presses;
  • Experience at large-scale research facilities (synchrotrons, neutron sources, or multi-user laboratories);
  • Knowledge of vacuum systems, cryogenics, furnaces, hydraulics, or pneumatics;
  • Experience with safety standards and experimental risk assessment.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno (DB2)
description:
Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 8,000 CI&Ters ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1,000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.

Importante : se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento de Lógica de Banco de Dados: Criar e manter scripts complexos, Stored Procedures, Functions e Triggers utilizando SQL e SQL Procedural Language;
  • Otimização e Tuning: Expertise no uso de ferramentas de Explain (db2exfmt, Visual Explain) para análise profunda de caminhos de acesso e métodos de join, visando a redução de consumo de recursos e tempo de resposta;
  • Manutenção de Performance: Executar e automatizar rotinas de manutenção essenciais, como RUNSTATS (atualização de estatísticas) e REORG (reorganização de tabelas e índices) para garantir a eficiência do storage;
  • Modelagem de Dados e Objetos: Atuar na concepção e alteração de tabelas, índices (B-tree, MDC, ITC) e views, além da gestão de Tablespaces (Bufferpools, Page Sizes), garantindo a integridade e a performance desde a camada física até o modelo lógico;
  • Troubleshooting e Concorrência: Diagnosticar problemas de performance em produção, como bloqueios (locks, deadlocks e timeouts), analisando níveis de isolamento e propondo melhorias estruturais ou de código para maximizar a concorrência.

Qualificações e Competências

  • Experiência com DB2 especificamente na versão LUW.
  • Domínio da ferramenta ERwin Data Modeler.
  • SQL Avançado: Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento procedural dentro do banco de dados.
  • Engenharia de Performance: Expertise técnica em criação e gestão de índices, particionamento de tabelas e compressão de dados.
  • Familiaridade com utilitários do DB2 (db2pd, db2top, db2advis) para monitoramento e diagnóstico.
  • Entendimento de como o banco de dados se integra ao pipeline de dados (ETL/ELT) e como otimizar o fluxo de grandes volumes de informação.
  • Domínio de utilitários de movimentação de dados em massa (EXPORT, IMPORT, LOAD e INGEST).

Certificações e Conhecimentos Avançados

  • Certificações IBM DB2 Administrator ou Database Specialist.
  • Conhecimento em integração de dados com ferramentas como InfoSphere - DataStage ou IBM MQ.
  • Experiência com Shell Scripting (Bash) para automação de tarefas no servidor.
  • Noções de infraestrutura (Storage, CPU, RAM) que impactam o comportamento do DB2.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico.

  • Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University).
  • Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem-estar.
  • Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável.

title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description:
We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division‑level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross‑org architectural decisions, negotiate trade‑offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high‑impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1‑click insurance products).

2026's vision and (how this role contributes)

In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data‑driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences , (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants , and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations . This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance .

Mission design and operationalize the 2–3 year technical end‑state for the Digital Ecosystem so that:

  • NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU),
  • Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue,
  • Insurance launches and scales high‑quality one‑click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture.

Core responsibilities

  • Support defining the division’s technical end‑state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade‑offs (cost × latency × availability).
  • Co‑own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs.
  • Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real‑time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX.
  • Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one‑click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS).
  • Support one‑stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech‑debt management to avoid blocking growth.
  • Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle.
  • Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post‑mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross‑BU initiatives.
  • Represent the division in cross‑org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively.
  • Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators.

Key business & engineering metrics you will influence

  • NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share‑of‑checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic.
  • Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch.
  • Insurance: one‑click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes.
  • Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners.

Challenges and opportunities (what you’ll own)

  • World‑class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first‑layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB).
  • Real‑time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low‑latency ads decisioning and NuPay real‑time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance.
  • One‑click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one‑click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control.
  • Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC.
  • Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One‑Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost‑effective infra.

What you’ll find in the team

  • High‑calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers.
  • Complex, high‑impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real‑time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi‑partner dependencies.
  • Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders.

What you’ll navigate

  • Heavy cross‑BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration.
  • Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re‑architecture or open‑scheme decisions.
  • Dependence on third‑party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations.
  • Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics.
  • Trade‑offs between accelerating one‑stack migration and accepting short‑term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity.

Job Description

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Engineer (FinOps) , you will build and scale data solutions that drive cost transparency and performance optimization across cloud environments. Leveraging SQL, Python, and modern orchestration tools, you’ll develop pipelines, datasets, and automation frameworks that enable accurate cost attribution and informed financial decision‑making. This role offers strong cross‑functional impact, working with Product, Engineering, and Finance to uncover cost‑saving opportunities and shape scalable, data‑driven FinOps practices.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, develop, and implement tooling and datasets for telemetry‑driven cost attribution and financial modeling;
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and automation frameworks for cost transparency and optimization;
  • Develop systems to identify cost‑saving opportunities and support discount modeling and management;
  • Ensure data accuracy and reliability through validation, auditing, and observability;
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Analytics stakeholders;
  • Improve scalability, performance, and reliability of ELT and ETL pipelines;
  • Support and enhance CI/CD processes and infrastructure automation.

MUST HAVES

  • 4+ years of experience in FinOps , Cloud Engineering , or Data Engineering ;
  • Strong experience with SQL and Python ;
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as dbt , Airflow , or Dagster ;
  • Experience designing and maintaining ELT/ETL pipelines ;
  • Strong background in data modeling and schema design ;
  • Experience with AWS services and Snowflake ;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform ;
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs ;
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP and observability tools like Datadog ;
  • Strong analytical skills with focus on data auditing and validation ;
  • FinOps certification ;
  • Upper‑intermediate English level .

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with Scala;
  • Experience with large‑scale datasets and distributed systems;
  • Understanding of cloud cost optimization strategies;
  • Experience in data‑driven and cross‑functional environments.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.

Descrição da vaga


We are looking for a highly motivated Product Engineer to lead the integration of transmission systems for hybrid and internal combustion vehicle platforms. This role requires a deep understanding of embedded control systems, diagnostics, and cross‑functional collaboration in a global environment.


The selected candidate will interface with systems and calibration engineers to align on functional requirements, assess impacts on regulatory and safety standards, and lead the implementation of software and diagnostic strategies. You will be responsible for ensuring software quality, calibration traceability, and validation of system performance throughout the product lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities



  • Interface with systems and calibration teams to interpret and refine control requirements.

  • Lead assessments and documentation related to regulatory compliance and functional safety.

  • Develop diagnostic strategies and clearly communicate with global stakeholders via reports and presentations.

  • Review and mark up control models to meet diagnostic and systems design criteria.

  • Manage software and calibration integration for automatic transmissions.

  • Track and document software versions, issues, and change requests.

  • Perform fault analysis, data acquisition, and control system validation (PID, cruise, performance).

  • Support software releases, troubleshooting, and vehicle‑level testing during development and production phases.



Qualificações



Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Fluent in English (written and verbal).

  • Experience with automotive ECUs, control systems, hydraulic/electrical subsystems, and combustion physics.

  • Solid knowledge of internal combustion engines and hybrid powertrain systems.

  • Familiarity with propulsion components (engine, driveline, electric/hydraulic subsystems).

  • Resumes in English.



Technical Skills:

  • V‑cycle software development process understanding.

  • Experience with problem‑solving techniques (DFMEA, DFSS, DVPR).

  • Basic knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

  • Knowledge of tools for project tracking and development workflows.

  • Understanding of development architectures such as aSPICE, PLE, AUTOSAR, and ISO 26262.

Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care.

Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.

Missão

Você será responsável por liderar a evolução de uma esteira de desenvolvimento autônoma, acelerada por inteligência artificial e coordenada por humanos, em uma grande instituição de ensino.   • Desenhar e orquestrar arquiteturas de agentes de IA (multi‑agents, workflows autônomos, copilots internos), integrando-as à esteira de desenvolvimento existente (SDLC, CI/CD, monitoramento, observabilidade)

Requisitos

  • Experiência prática com engenharia de prompts e desenho de fluxos multi‑agentes (divisão de papéis entre agentes, coordenação, handoff para humanos)
  • Conhecimento em RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), uso de vetores/embeddings e integração de modelos com bases de conhecimento internas (documentação, código, wiki, etc.)
  • Entendimento de limitações, riscos e vieses de modelos de IA generativa, com capacidade de desenhar salvaguardas (guardrails, validação de respostas, filtros, etc.)
  • Domínio sobre a aplicabilidade e limitações dos principais modelos do mercado (Claude, GPT, Gemini)
  • Experiência prévia em construção de plataformas internas de desenvolvimento (Developer Platform / Internal Developer Platform – IDP)
  • Experiência com CI/CD, automação de pipelines e integração com múltiplos ambientes
  • Perfil hands‑on, com mentalidade de automação e eficiência operacional
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento seguro, incluindo mitigação de ameaças e aplicação de contra‑medidas
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de construir relacionamento com pessoas ao seu redor

Você irá se destacar se

  • Possuir experiência em ambientes de alta complexidade organizacional (ex.: grandes instituições de ensino, bancos, grandes empresas de serviços)
  • Contribuições para comunidades técnicas (open source, palestras, artigos, meetups)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de qualidade de código e produtividade potencializadas por IA (code review assistido, geração de testes automatizados, etc.)

Benefícios

title: Sr. Mes Analyst (Manufacturing Systems)
description:
Role Summary

The Senior MES Analyst, in partnership with Operational Excellence (OpEx), will work with Production, Quality, and Supply teams to ensure the proper implementation and management of the Manufacturing Execution System (MES – Werum PAS‑X), as well as its ongoing optimization and data extraction for statistical process control.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the PAS‑X lifecycle (analysis, design, build, testing, validation, deployment, and sustainment).
  • Map processes (AS‑IS/TO‑BE) and translate requirements into MES models (eBR/eDHR, recipes, material specs, equipment, parameters).
  • Build and maintain PAS‑X artifacts:
    • GMBR/PMBR with version control and block reuse.
    • PVL/PLL and element libraries (units, equipment, materials, IPC).
    • CIX/Integration configurations (ERP/LIMS/shopfloor) and data mapping.
    • Workflows, rules, checks, sampling, deviations, and electronic signatures (RbE).
    • Weighing/Dispensing, Execution, Review‑by‑Exception, and Release templates.
  • Integrate PAS‑X with SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA, LIMS, historians, SCADA/PLC, and shop‑floor devices.
  • Define, specify, and test MES–SAP integrations (process orders, BOM/recipes, batches, status, WM/EWM, QM, PI sheets where applicable).
  • Execute CSV per GAMP 5 (URS/FRS, Risk Assessment, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability).
  • Ensure compliance (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+).
  • Monitor KPIs and incidents; drive improvements (OEE, RFT, deviation reduction).
  • Train key users; develop SOPs, manuals, and training materials.
  • Support audits, Change Control (ITIL), and CAPA plans.
  • Ensure effective expansion, maintenance, and optimization of PAS‑X in a manufacturing environment.
  • Troubleshoot and provide technical support.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally to analyze production processes, data integration, and drive MES improvements with production teams.
  • Use manufacturing systems to track production performance and establish KPIs, including:
    • Yield: Monitor the percentage of defect‑free products to meet quality standards.
    • Cycle Time: Assess time to complete a production cycle to optimize processes.
    • Resource Utilization: Evaluate machine and labor utilization to maximize efficiency.
    • Inventory Turnover: Measure speed of converting raw materials into finished goods for effective inventory management.
    • Scrap Rate: Track the percentage of discarded materials to minimize waste.
  • Communicate risk situations to EHS per the DISK 1000 program. Prevent unsafe acts by following area procedures.
  • Use and care for assigned PPE.
  • Maintain equipment in your area of responsibility.
  • Safeguard the confidentiality of sensitive information.
  • Comply with the company’s Code of Conduct, policies, and regulations.

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Data Analytics, Chemistry, Biology, and/or Pharmacy.
  • Solid of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Solid experience in MES; 3+ years with Werum PAS‑X in a regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in:
    • Building GMBR/PMBR, PVL/PLL, and libraries in PAS‑X.
    • Configuring MBR/eBR (Dispensing, Execution, Review by Exception).
    • MES–SAP ECC integrations (S/4HANA desirable): PP‑PI (process orders, PI sheets/similar), QM (results/postings), MM/WM/EWM (materials, batches, movements), and common interfaces (IDoc, BAPI, RFC, PI/PO or CPI).
    • CSV/GAMP 5 (URS/FRS, IQ/OQ/PQ, evidence and audit trails). Differential.
    • Compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and Data Integrity. Differential.

Requirements and Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with: Microsoft Office, SAP, Ariba, MODA, PAS‑X.
  • Advanced English.
  • Negotiation and conflict management skills.
  • Ability to work under delivery schedules.
  • Project management skills.
  • Ability to lead projects and work both independently and in teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, including presenting complex topics to non‑technical audiences.
  • Experience with at least one automated data transformation.
  • Strong critical thinking and reasoning, especially for troubleshooting data.
  • Passion for solving complex problems and making an impact.
  • Experience developing KPI dashboards.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Description

United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.

Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.

What You Will Do

Semantic Modeling

  • Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
  • Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
  • Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption

Data Documentation and Context

  • Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
  • Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
  • Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata

AI Readiness

  • Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
  • Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
  • Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope

Governance and Quality

  • Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
  • Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
  • Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
  • Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
  • Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
  • Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
  • Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
  • Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
  • Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
  • Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing

Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high‑quality software companies, providing long‑term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Gemini’s portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com

The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.

In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust‑based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high‑quality software businesses. Relationship‑building in this role is a long‑term endeavor – often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high‑quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.

As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil‑based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function – including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal‑sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.

Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship‑building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long‑term build‑out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high‑quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.

About us

Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page:

About the team

The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership.

The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit.

About the role

You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders.

You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy.
  • Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI‑DSS).
  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk‑based and scalable way.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
  • Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues.
  • Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks.
  • Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems.
  • Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward‑looking, data‑driven insights to senior management and Committees.
  • Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally.

Qualification Requirements

  • Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI‑DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar.
  • Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.
  • Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields.
  • Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM‑based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases.
  • Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts.
  • Advanced English (written and verbal) required.

Nice to have Requirements

  • Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus.

International experience is highly desirable.

title: Assistente de Loja - Campinas
description:
O QUE VAI FAZER

Como Assistente de Loja na H&M, você desempenhará um papel fundamental na criação de uma experiência excepcional para o cliente. Você dará as boas-vindas aos clientes, os guiará pela loja e os apoiará a encontrar o que precisam enquanto apresenta nossos produtos. Agindo de acordo com nossos valores, você contribuirá para o seu próprio sucesso e para o sucesso da empresa.

Você irá:

  • Compartilhar seu conhecimento de moda e produtos para ajudar os clientes a fazer escolhas informadas.
  • Colaborar com sua equipe para oferecer um serviço excepcional em todas as etapas da jornada do cliente.
  • Certificar-se de que a área de vendas e os fundos da casa estejam bem abastecidos, organizados e convidativos.
  • Suportar com abertura e fechamento da loja.
  • Representar a si mesmo e à marca positivamente durante todas as interações com o cliente.

COM QUEM VOCÊ TRABALHARÁ

Nossas lojas são o coração de nossa empresa, onde os clientes experimentam nossa marca em primeira mão. Como parte da dinâmica equipe de loja, todas as funções – assistentes de loja, coordenadores de departamento, gerentes de loja, visual merchandisers e analistas administrativos e financeiros - contribuem para criar um ambiente inspirador e acolhedor. Você também se conectará com a equipe de área mais ampla, colaborando entre as lojas para compartilhar insights e impulsionar o sucesso juntos. Ao lado de sua equipe, você desempenhará um papel vital em ajudar os clientes a se sentirem confiantes e expressarem sua individualidade com as últimas tendências e estilos atemporais. Ao construir conexões significativas com os clientes em nossas lojas, tornamos a moda acessível e sustentável para todos.

QUEM VOCÊ É

Estamos à procura de pessoas com:

  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente em moda, varejo ou áreas afins.

E as pessoas que são:

  • Apaixonado por moda e por oferecer uma experiência excepcional na loja, promovendo nossos produtos e impulsionando as vendas.
  • Prosperando em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos.
  • Comunicativo, criativo, curioso para trabalhar com tecnologia de loja, com forte vontade de aprender e se desenvolver.
  • Flexível e orientado para a ação.

QUEM SOMOS

O H&M Group é uma empresa global de fortes marcas e empreendimentos de moda. Nosso objetivo é provar que não há compromisso entre design excepcional, preços acessíveis e soluções sustentáveis. Queremos liberar a moda para muitos, e nossos clientes estão no centro de todas as decisões que tomamos.

Somos formados por milhares de colegas apaixonados e talentosos, unidos por nossa cultura e valores compartilhados. Juntos, queremos usar nosso poder, nossa escala e nosso conhecimento para impulsionar a indústria da moda em direção a um futuro mais inclusivo e sustentável.

POR QUE VOCÊ VAI ADORAR TRABALHAR AQUI

No Grupo H&M, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa vibrante e acolhedora. Oferecemos aos nossos funcionários benefícios atraentes com amplas oportunidades de desenvolvimento em todo o mundo.

JUNTE-SE A NÓS

Nossa singularidade vem de uma combinação de muitas coisas – nossa cultura inclusiva e colaborativa, nossos fortes valores e oportunidades de crescimento. Mas, acima de tudo, são as nossas pessoas que nos tornam quem somos.

Dê o próximo passo em sua carreira junto conosco. A jornada começa aqui.

Avaliação de funções da loja:

Para gerenciar o alto volume de inscrições para a função de Assistente de Loja, usamos um método de avaliação on-line para recrutamento baseado em habilidades em algumas de nossas lojas. Você precisará preenchê-lo como parte do processo de inscrição e triagem. As suas respostas serão pontuadas por uma ferramenta de avaliação que aplica critérios predefinidos definidos pelo Grupo H&M.

Depois de concluir a avaliação, você terá a oportunidade de compartilhar feedback e fazer perguntas. Se você tiver alguma dificuldade ou preferir um método de avaliação alternativo, entre em contato com A escolha de uma alternativa não afetará sua inscrição.

Para obter mais informações sobre como processamos seus dados pessoais, consulte nosso Aviso de Privacidade.

Estamos comprometidos com um processo de recrutamento justo, equitativo e baseado na competência. Portanto, pedimos que você não anexe uma carta de apresentação em sua inscrição.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Engineer Manager
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. - Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth. - Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development. - Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions. - Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value. - Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation. - Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope. - Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment. - Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS). - Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members. - Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente. Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes. Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem. Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa. Esperamos que você tenha: Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio). Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk). Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD. Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts. Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial): Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure). Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker. Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura. Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure) Contratação: PJ.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.
- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.
- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.
- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis. Requisitos Necessários: - Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.
- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.
- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.
- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).
- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).
- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.
- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar). Diferenciais: - Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.
- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.
- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.
- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados. Modelo de Trabalho - Remoto - Contratação PJ Benefícios ATRA: - TotalPass - Reembolso 100% em certificações - Parcerias educacionais - Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas - Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta Sobre a ATRA Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Proficiência na linguagem C e em assembly, com foco em sistemas de alto desempenho e em desenvolvimento para ambientes sem sistema operacional (bare metal) e em kernel-space. Ao menos 5 anos de experiência com a adaptação (porting) e bring-up do kernel Linux para novos plataformas, e implementação e adaptação de device drivers. Conhecimentos sobre a arquitetura e detalhes de implementação do kernel Linux, como gerenciamento de memória, escalonadores, processos, threads, etc. Experiência com ferramentas para geração de sistemas Linux, como Buildroot e Yocto, e ferramentas de emulação e depuração, como QEMU e GDB. Desejável : Conhecimentos da arquitetura RISC-V, em especial assembly para RISC-V, processo de boot, Supervisor Binary Interface (SBI), mecanismos de interrupção (CLINT, PLIC, APLIC), modelo de memória, mecanismos de sincronização e operações atômicas. Conhecimento em otimização de desempenho. Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls (chamadas de sistema) para utilizar os recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V. Conhecimentos e experiência com bootloaders e códigos de inicialização: UEFI, U-Boot, EDK II, Open-SBI. Contribuições em projetos de código aberto. Conhecimento em análise e otimização de desempenho. Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls para utilização dos recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V Experiência na caracterização (profiling) de desempenho de aplicações e uso de ferramentas como perf e eBPF.
