title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

description: We are looking for an\ "LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing. Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization). Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space. Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization. description: A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office. Quem somos: Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia! Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R). Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações O que oferecemos: VR/VT Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) Gympass Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour! Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!) Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós: Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados. Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender. Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA. Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks, data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh, data products, and Unity Catalog–based governance. This is a hands-on architect role, requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Solution & Data Architecture Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration). Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions. Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks. Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management. Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools. Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies. Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards. Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk. Remain hands-on with: Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment. Collaboration & Delivery Alignment Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction. Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs. Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution. Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design. Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows. Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Sr. Ai Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken) Please upload your CV Resume in English. Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You're the person who makes AI products real. The role: They have prototypes that work. What they don't have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You'll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You'll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director. This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You'll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application. What you'll do: Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You'll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users. Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills. Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed. Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe. Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won't be customer-facing, but you'll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it. Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You'll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy. Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You'll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use. Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You'll adopt and improve this system. Tech you'll work with: Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.Js, React Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI. AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol) Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products. Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0 You don't need to be a data engineer, but you'll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics. Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You'll own the path from merged PR to running in production. What they're looking for: Must-haves AI engineering experience. You've built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems. You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully. Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.Js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI. Production shipping muscle. You've taken something from "it works on my machine" to "it's running in production with real users." CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real. Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say "this seems wrong" when it does. No yes-people. AI agent systems experience. You've built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents;
you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system. AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty. Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries. Nice-to-haves: Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics Snowflake / SQL analytics experience Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX Azure cloud platform experience LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime How our partner works: Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn't optional it's how they ship quality at speed with a small team. Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership. Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say "not yet available," not fake numbers. Documentation as code. CLAUDE.Md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase. Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable. Benefits: A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays. *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Na Proffer, nossa missão é promover relações ganha-ganha entre vendedores e compradores usando algoritmos de Inteligência Artificial e Advanced Analytics para encontrar preços justos no varejo, aumentando o lucro do vendedor sem impactar o preço médio para o consumidor. Estamos em busca de alguém para atuar como Coordenador(a) de Integrações ERP, liderando nosso time técnico e garantindo que os dados de ERPs e PDVs do varejo farmacêutico cheguem com precisão à nossa plataforma. Aqui, você não só coordenará, mas também “colocará a mão na massa” em SQL, ETL e processos de integração. Aqui você vai trabalhar com: Liderar o time de especialistas em integrações, definindo prioridades e garantindo a qualidade das entregas Criar, testar e otimizar queries complexas e fluxos de ETL em diversos bancos de dados (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Firebird etc.) Conectar novos clientes à Proffer na prática (implantação hands-on) Resolver incidentes complexos de integração e inconsistência de dados (suporte nível 3) Navegar e trabalhar com estruturas de dados dos principais ERPs/PDVs do varejo farmacêutico (Linx, Trier, Inovafarma, Softpharma etc.) Procuramos alguém que: Tenha experiência com ERPs e PDVs do varejo farmacêutico Graduação completa em uma das seguintes áreas: Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, e similares. Domine SQL e ETL e saiba manipular dados avançados Tenha perfil resolutivo, autonomia e experiência em liderar times Possua infraestrutura própria para trabalho remoto (computador/laptop com configuração adequada) Seria interessante se você tivesse (mas não é obrigatório): Conhecimento em linguagens de automação (Python, Node.Js) Experiência prévia em Software Houses do setor farmacêutico O que oferecemos: Trabalho 100% remoto, com flexibilidade de horários Autonomia de verdade (sem microgerenciamento) Espaço para crescer rápido (junto com a empresa) Ambiente de alta responsabilidade — e alta confiança Crescimento de remuneração baseado em performance Incentivo constante para aprendizado e desenvolvimento técnico Oportunidade de liderar e estruturar uma área crítica para o negócio

title: Back End Developer
description: About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Data Scientist - Catálogo
description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Catálogo, com foco em qualidade, enriquecimento e padronização de dados de produtos, utilizando técnicas de Inteligência artificial. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução do catálogo como ativo central do negócio, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia, Design e Negócio. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções baseadas em IA e Machine Learning para enriquecimento automático de produtos, como: Padronização de descrições e títulos Inferência e sugestão de atributos Classificação e reclassificação de produtos Atuar na definição e otimização de: Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos Métricas de qualidade de catálogo (completude, consistência, acurácia e unicidade) Trabalhar com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo abordagens baseadas em NLP e LLMs, quando aplicável. Avaliar e evoluir métricas que conectem qualidade de catálogo com impacto em negócio e experiência do usuário (ex: conversão, busca, recomendação). Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar o impacto das melhorias de enriquecimento e qualidade do catálogo. Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio na definição do roadmap técnico de catálogo. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento das soluções baseadas em IA. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas e decisões analíticas. Requisitos necessários: Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados. Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital. Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes). Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua. Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace. Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados. Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados. Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre sistemas. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos). Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI. Perfil esperado: Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto de negócio. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares. #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Data Scientist
description:
Be a part of a fast‑paced culture and community in a startup‑like environment inside one of the most successful organizations in Québec. We are focused on building a highly talented and ambitious team from the ground up that revolutionizes the way we work around Data & Analytics at BRP. We are a team that has the potential to unlock tremendous value for the organization and you have the unique opportunity to be part of it from the beginning.

Join BRP's central Data & Analytics team (DNA) as a Data Scientist and bring your analytical skills and business insight to our dynamic team. This role is perfect for someone who seeks to blend their understanding of business intelligence with the predictive power of data science to unlock new opportunities for BRP.

You’ll Have The Opportunity To
  • Partner with Product Manager, Product Owner and business stakeholders to identify high‑impact opportunities and translate business questions into well‑defined analytical problems and ML use cases
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non‑technical stakeholders through compelling data storytelling
  • Design and develop machine learning models and statistical analyses that directly address business needs, with clear success metrics tied to outcomes and ensure model validity, fairness, and interpretability
  • Design and execute rigorous A/B tests, experiments, and causal inference studies to validate model performance and measure business impact
  • Stay current with rapid developments in ML/AI, especially foundation models, LLMs, and agentic systems, evaluate their applicability to business problems, and champion adoption where appropriate
You’ll Thrive In This Role If You Have The Following Skills And Qualities Education & Experience
  • MSc (preferred) or BSc in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent quantitative field
  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience applying data science and machine learning to solve real business problems
  • Demonstrated track record of projects where your work drove measurable business outcomes
Technical Skills
  • Strong Python proficiency for data analysis, modeling and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs and tools (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar) for prototyping and implementing AI‑powered solutions
  • Solid SQL skills and experience querying data warehouses (Snowflake experience is a plus)
  • Familiarity with at least one end‑to‑end ML platform (Dataiku, Databricks, Vertex AI, SageMaker) for experimentation and model development
  • Understanding of ML fundamentals: model evaluation, cross‑validation, hyperparameter tuning, bias‑variance tradeoff, MLOps
Language Requirements
  • Fluent in English (spoken/written), team communication is primarily in English
  • French is a huge plus
Stand Out With
  • Experience building production applications or proof‑of‑concepts using LLMs, including prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval‑Augmented Generation), or fine‑tuning approaches
  • Familiarity with emerging AI agent frameworks and orchestration tools
  • Experience with model explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME) and fairness/bias assessment in production contexts
  • Familiarity with the handoff process to production: understanding of model monitoring needs, drift detection, and retraining triggers
  • Background in a specific domain relevant to our business and Machine Learning expertise
  • Contributions to open‑source projects or publications demonstrating thought leadership
  • Experience mentoring junior data scientists or leading analytical initiatives
Acknowledging the Power of Diversity

BRP is dedicated to nurturing a culture that invites, connects, and propels the ambitions of people of all backgrounds, profiles, beliefs and experiences. Ultimately, the diversity and uniqueness of our people fuel our ingenuity and set the course for the path ahead! For this reason, we value diversity and we strive to always push each other forward to build an inclusive workplace where every employee feels like they belong, where they can grow and find meaning.

Welcome to BRP

We’re a world leader in recreational vehicles and boats, creating innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt and even in the air. Headquartered in the Canadian town of Valcourt, Quebec, our company is rooted in a spirit of ingenuity and intense customer focus. Today, we operate manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Finland, Australia and Austria, with a workforce made up of close to 16,500 spirited people, all driven by the deeply held belief that at work, as with life itself, it’s not about the destination; It’s about the journey.

This position is based in Campinas, Brazil. You will have the opportunity to work in hybrid mode. Resumes in English will be preferred.

description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Program Manager to lead global initiatives across multiple regions, with a strong focus on analytics-driven products within BEES ONE. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in managing complex projects, possess exceptional communication and negotiation skills, and effectively manage cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Fluency in English is required, while proficiency in Spanish is highly desirable but not mandatory.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys working with data-oriented initiatives, and is motivated by delivering insights that drive business decisions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Program Management: Lead the end-to-end implementation of multiple concurrent projects, from initial planning through execution and phased deliveries.

  • Strategic Planning and Execution: Drive quarterly planning cycles, defining project roadmaps, timelines, prioritization, and resource allocation using tools like Jira.
  • Analytics Product Delivery: Oversee the development and delivery of analytics dashboards, ensuring alignment with business needs and enabling data-driven decision-making.
  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and blockers, actively driving resolution and maintaining project momentum.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize data and performance metrics to track progress and ensure successful delivery of initiatives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contribute to improving project management processes, enhancing efficiency, and scaling best practices across the team.
  • Support and Customer Service: Ensure delivered solutions meet internal customer needs, particularly supporting commercial and business teams with actionable insights.
Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
  • Experience: Proven experience managing multiple mid-sized technology or data-related projects in parallel, ideally within global or product-driven environments.
  • Skills: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and drive alignment across diverse teams.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is mandatory (advanced level preferred). Proficiency in Spanish is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge: Experience or familiarity with data/analytics environments is a strong plus.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira) and agile methodologies.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and support decision-making processes.
  • Attributes: Proactive, hands-on, highly communicative, and able to manage multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and blockers effectively.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

#TaxEY

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa de Tributos Indiretos você será parte da área de TAX atuando em ajudar nossos clientes a identificar áreas de riscos, oportunidades de planejamento sustentável ao longo do ciclo de vida dos impostos indiretos e apoiar no cumprimento de obrigações de conformidade e metas de negócios em todo o mundo, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como especialista em várias equipes de atendimento ao cliente, participando de projetos na área de Tributos Indiretos, oferecendo assistência na identificação de áreas de risco e oportunidades de planejamento sustentável em Impostos Indiretos em todas as etapas de incidência de impostos;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, os profissionais da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS e ISS);
  • Habilidades de gestão de projetos.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, Compliance e Planejamento Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Acesse go.ey.com/beneficios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

“Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas para as pessoas Pretas e Pardas e, e exclusiva para PcDs. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.”
